mapper.select: SELECT b.bucket_key AS bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT b.user_id) AS active_users, SUM(b.active_seconds) AS active_seconds FROM ( SELECT a.user_id, CASE #{granularity} WHEN 'month' THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.eff_start, '%Y-%m') WHEN 'week' THEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(a.eff_start, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(a.eff_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(a.eff_start, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS bucket_key, CASE WHEN a.ended_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST( GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, a.eff_start, a.ended_at), 0) - GREATEST(COALESCE(a.paused_duration_ms, 0), 0) / 1000, 0 ) END AS active_seconds FROM ( SELECT user_id, ended_at, paused_duration_ms, COALESCE(started_at, created_at) AS eff_start FROM act_practice_attempt WHERE COALESCE(started_at, created_at) >= #{from} AND COALESCE(started_at, created_at) <= #{to} AND status <> #{readyStatus} ) a ) b GROUP BY b.bucket_key ORDER BY b.bucket_key

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS active_users, SUM(a.active_seconds) AS active_seconds, COUNT(*) AS practice_visits, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = #{completedStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_visits FROM ( SELECT user_id, status, CASE WHEN ended_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST( GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, COALESCE(started_at, created_at), ended_at), 0) - GREATEST(COALESCE(paused_duration_ms, 0), 0) / 1000, 0 ) END AS active_seconds FROM act_practice_attempt WHERE COALESCE(started_at, created_at) >= #{from} AND COALESCE(started_at, created_at) <= #{to} AND status <> #{readyStatus} ) a
